research_rationale:
EO 12879 (58 FR 59929) of November 8, 1993 fixes the order of succession of officers to act as Secretary of the Navy. The held original (two Federal Register pages) was read in full and confirmed to be the order (number, date and subject agree with the register row). The eleven clauses cover the whole text; none has an own-terms end, no held later instrument amends, revokes or supersedes the order, and the three bounded searches found no ending statement. All clauses are carried as operative through 2026-10-14.
